completeness_contract.constant_removal: Every gate can be replaced by a zero-preserving gate plus a free affine correction, propagated to all later operands/output decoders. The target is zero-preserving, so no final constant is needed.
completeness_contract.GL2: A plane-basis change changes a Boolean product by an available linear form. Highest-pivot normalization preserves a representative of every independent plane; redundant gates may be removed or zero-left padded.
completeness_contract.decoder: All raw input and prior gate coefficients are arbitrary; no output basis, target direction or intergate ordering is fixed beyond the three previously audited first-plane representatives.
completeness_contract.nested_witnesses: Target intersections modulo affine are nested. The dimension bound m-(k-i) allows a common independent nested target basis; every nonempty rectangular lambda row sum is constrained nonzero.
completeness_contract.minimum_dependencies: The reviewed quadratic flattening lemma plus certified parallel-nine exclusion rules out any <=8 GF16 solution with at most one syntactically dependent gate. This is not implied by the prefix lemma alone.
completeness_contract.higher_degree_before_last: If every earlier gate is quadratic, a quadratic last gate flattens to a forbidden parallel circuit; a nonquadratic last gate is absent from every quadratic output and removable. This never requires the last gate itself to be quadratic.
completeness_contract.theorem_status: Mathematical argument and independently replayed finite kernel/parallel-certificate results, not a proof-assistant formalization. Those old results were read, not rerun here.
completeness_contract.unused_edge_case: Inherited campaign uses history[0] if no iteration is attempted; positive current budgets produced nonempty histories. This does not affect these saved traces.

abstract_flag_check.scope: Finite complete check for independent eight-coordinate gate space. The quotient-dimension proof separately covers dependent or padded gate spaces.

report.json.limits: Toy cancellation controls refute generic inferences, not possible additional GF16-specific theorems. No solver-speed measurement or new candidate circuit.

countercontrol-report.json.not_counterexample_to: Any proved GF16-specific or minimal-circuit condition; this toy is not GF16 and is not gate-minimal.

logic-report.json.scope: At least two distinct dependent gates is GF16-specific here. A quartic-three control with that cut deliberately selects a valid chain and excludes a different valid balanced realization.

independent_root_linear_map_and_logic_ch.scope_of_linear_map_identity: All zero-preserving eight-input Boolean functions, by equality on all 255 basis truths.

rejected_stronger_prefix_hypothesis.counterexample_to: Claim that a rank8 scalar quadratic with useful nonquadratic intermediates needs at least6 ANDs.
